items.title: Colonel Douglas Macgregor: America and Israel Have Lost Iran War
items.quote: Transcripts: Welcome back to Real Talk with Cyrus Jansen and today we have a special guest in the studio, Colonel Douglas McGregor. You know, I wanted to get you back on the show because we are looking at a very big escalation, you know, potentially here in the United States and Iran war. And, you know, it seems that Donald Trump seems to be going further and further down this escalation trap. We're over five months in. There doesn't seem to be really anything accomplished by the United States military. uh very little strategic goals accomplished and really just a lot of chaos and a lot of uncertainty. Uh we're approaching the beginning of August. What is your take right now on the Iran war?
